title: Invariance outside the free coordinates
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $J\subseteq\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, and let $f$ map sign vectors of length $n$ to a set $\alpha$. Fix signs on the coordinates outside $J$, and form a new sign vector by taking its coordinates in $J$ from the input and its other coordinates from those fixed signs. Changing an input coordinate $i\notin J$ to either sign $b\in\{\pm1\}$ leaves the value of this restricted function unchanged.
hypotheses_covered: $J$ is a finite set of indices in $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$
$f$ maps sign vectors of length $n$ to $\alpha$
$x$ is a sign vector of length $n$
